sampling.note: Held-out seed comparison; separate from the required 500-episode evaluation.

final_policy.std_convention: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1); reported as 0 for one episode, where uncertainty is not estimable.

initial_policy.std_convention: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1); reported as 0 for one episode, where uncertainty is not estimable.

random_policy.std_convention: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1); reported as 0 for one episode, where uncertainty is not estimable.

final_vs_random.inference_note: Percentile interval over paired evaluation seeds; it does not measure variability across independent training runs.

final_vs_initial.inference_note: Percentile interval over paired evaluation seeds; it does not measure variability across independent training runs.

comparison.expectation: A learned frozen policy should outperform untrained and random policies under fixed exploration settings.

perturbation.experiment: Normal observations versus all-zero image input with matched reset seeds.
perturbation.expectation: A visually informed policy may outperform its blackout version; the measured difference decides.

blackout_policy.std_convention: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1); reported as 0 for one episode, where uncertainty is not estimable.

normal_minus_blackout.inference_note: Percentile interval over paired evaluation seeds; it does not measure variability across independent training runs.

perturbation.interpretation: Only network inputs change; environment dynamics and raw game scoring stay unchanged. Paired seeds do not force identical trajectories after actions diverge.

target_audit.expected_rule: Reward only at true termination; bootstrap across time truncation.
target_audit.scope: Checks only recorded transitions, not every replay-buffer update.

boundaries.time_limit_rule: Time truncation ends rollout, but does not zero the Bellman bootstrap.
boundaries.life_loss_note: Validation does not impose life-loss endings; scores are full-environment episode rewards.

limitations: One selected training seed cannot establish robustness across training seeds.
Confidence intervals quantify seed variation within this evaluation protocol only.
Perturbation performance is not a replacement for standard-environment evaluation.
